+Historical import requires an existing resolved profile with tracking and personalization explicitly stored as `true`; it cannot create a profile or grant consent. Multiple supplied identifiers must resolve to the same subject. Missing state or consent and refused consent are reported by original row index in `skipped`, without changing profile or history counts; corrupt state and failed writes fail the request, which may follow earlier successful subject groups. Original times remain subject to erasure cutoffs; consent/identity/erasure operations across stores are not atomic.
 
+JSON also accepts `{ kind: "profile", version: 1, source: "crm", visitorId: "…", at: "2026-09-01T00:00:00Z", fields: { tier: { type: "string", meaning: "Declared loyalty tier", value: "gold" } }, audiences: { vip: "Provider-defined VIP membership" } }`. Each row is a complete replacement for one source: omitted fields/memberships are withdrawn. Types are `string`, finite `number`, `boolean`, and `string-set`; no coercion or invented event weights. Keys use1–64 ASCII letters/digits/underscore/hyphen excluding prototype names; values are at most256 characters, meanings512, string sets32 elements, fields/audiences32 each. A profile holds at most8 sources and64KiB serialized enrichment. Future snapshots refuse; older rows skip; identical equal-time retries skip without writes; conflicting equal-time payloads fail. Empty maps withdraw values/memberships but retain the source/time replay watermark, not full privacy erasure. Link merges sources with the same ordering/conflict/bounds rules; local erasure removes the co-located snapshots. Only applied behavioral rows increment historical-event counts.
+
+Published local audience rules can target `external.crm.tier`; precomputed membership is `external.crm.vip`. Existing consent-safe segment and personalization reads qualify current typed-plus-live inputs, including after replacement; live events and object alarms preserve these memberships. Values and provenance remain separate from behavioral counters, numerical affinity and decision-provider attributes. This delivers local typed segmentation, not numerical content/product score mapping, typed CSV/S3 adapters, scheduled warehouse sharing, purchased-data rights approval, transactional replay/erasure or customer acceptance. Field meanings and usage rights must be established by the data owner.
+
 ## 4. Content and configuration documents
 
 Four documents per brand, each with the same seven routes. `kind` is `catalog`, `slots`, `learn` or
 `priors`; `scope` is the brand.
